decisions.reason: The source establishes an overall aesthetic reference but does not necessarily change the existing decorative-lighting requirement, LED selection, or lighting scope.
The controls already reference the supplied renderings and DJ-booth styling; the broad aesthetic instruction adds no necessary candidate-specific state change.
The machine color scheme already uses the CAD renderings as its reference, and the source does not establish a different color or finish.
The general aesthetic-reference decision does not necessarily alter the placard text, position, viewing orientation, or two-sided presentation.
The source does not explicitly change or supersede the established cursive E markings, their coverage, or their color.
A same-message MODIFY already captures the required base aesthetic reference, and no additional branding update or removal is entailed.
The base finish already must match the supplied reference exactly; the source introduces no distinct finish change.
The spout already has a rendering-based appearance requirement, and the source does not change its material, fabrication, or specific appearance criteria.
The aesthetic-reference decision does not necessarily alter the support base's cup-clearance function, height, supported cup size, or footprint alignment.
Aesthetic reproduction of the reference renderings does not change the machine's stability or structural-support requirements.
The source does not resolve or modify the functional power-control method; a general aesthetic reference is insufficient to select a different switch or button.
The visual-reference decision does not change the functional splash-control target, speed condition, or mitigation options.
